title: Zero-Pending-Acceptance deadlines by account
keywords: deadline zero pending acceptance by when outsource by 5pm 6pm 7pm 7.30pm tiktok shopee sgh tsuklio
body: Shopee/Lazada: outsource non-movables by 4.30pm; zero Pending Acceptance by 5pm.
TikTok afternoon: outsource by 5pm; zero Pending Acceptance by 6pm.
TikTok evening: outsource by 7pm; zero Pending Acceptance by 7.30pm; all evening pickups done by 8pm.
SGH same-day: all assigned, zero Pending Acceptance by 1–2pm and again 4–5pm.
Tsuklio: all assigned by 2pm; drivers at 28 Tai Seng by 3pm.
Telemedical: night duty from 7.30pm; Minmed not accepted by 8.30pm → Lalamove; all delivered by 9pm.
